title: Ask For A Skip, Get SKIPPED 🛼
description:
My best friend had his birthday at the roller rink, and I didn't know anybody else there. The DJ will skip any song you ask him to, so every time things got awkward, I asked.

He doesn't skip the song. And every time I asked, the skater in the faded stripes was standing a little nearer.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SKIP if you'd have skipped the speech too.
